1: import TGLExt.ContinuousModularZero
2: import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Notation
3: 
4: set_option autoImplicit false
5: set_option maxHeartbeats 800000
6: namespace TGLExt.EquationOfTruth.ModularGeneratorControl
7: open Matrix NormedSpace
8: open scoped ComplexOrder MatrixOrder
9: noncomputable section
10: variable {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
11: 
12: /-- Vanishing of the generator on y is commutation with rho for a positive definite rho. -/
13: theorem modularGen_zero_iff_commute (ρ y : Matrix n n ℂ) (hρ : ρ.PosDef) :
14:     TGLExt.modularGen ρ y = 0 ↔ Commute ρ y := by
15:   constructor
16:   · intro h
17:     have hc : Commute (TGLExt.logRho ρ) y := by
18:       show TGLExt.logRho ρ*y = y*TGLExt.logRho ρ
19:       exact (sub_eq_zero.mp h).symm
20:     have he := hc.exp_left
21:     rwa [TGLExt.exp_logRho ρ hρ] at he
22:   · intro hc
23:     have hl := hc.cfc_real Real.log
24:     unfold TGLExt.modularGen TGLExt.logRho
25:     rw [hl.eq, sub_self]
26: 
27: theorem scalar_modularGen_zero (c : ℂ) (y : Matrix n n ℂ) :
28:     TGLExt.modularGen (c • (1:Matrix n n ℂ)) y = 0 := by
29:   have hc : Commute (c • (1:Matrix n n ℂ)) y := by
30:     show (c • (1:Matrix n n ℂ))*y = y*(c • (1:Matrix n n ℂ))
31:     simp [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
32:   have hl := hc.cfc_real Real.log
33:   unfold TGLExt.modularGen TGLExt.logRho
34:   rw [hl.eq, sub_self]
35: 
36: def rhoExample : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := diagonal ![1/3,2/3]
37: def matrixUnit : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := !![0,1;0,0]
38: 
39: theorem rhoExample_posDef : rhoExample.PosDef := by
40:   rw [rhoExample, Matrix.posDef_diagonal_iff]
41:   intro i
42:   fin_cases i <;> norm_num
43: 
44: theorem rhoExample_trace : Matrix.trace rhoExample = 1 := by
45:   norm_num [rhoExample, Matrix.trace, Fin.sum_univ_two]
46: 
47: theorem example_generator_nonzero : TGLExt.modularGen rhoExample matrixUnit ≠ 0 := by
48:   intro hz
49:   have hc := (modularGen_zero_iff_commute rhoExample matrixUnit rhoExample_posDef).mp hz
50:   have he := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ => M 0 1) hc.eq
51:   norm_num [rhoExample, matrixUnit, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] at he
52: 
53: theorem exists_normalized_nonzero_generator :
54:     ∃ ρ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ, ρ.PosDef ∧ Matrix.trace ρ=1 ∧ TGLExt.modularGen ρ ≠ 0 := by
55:   refine ⟨rhoExample, rhoExample_posDef, rhoExample_trace, ?_⟩
56:   intro h
57:   apply example_generator_nonzero
58:   exact congrFun h matrixUnit
